summary: Q2 FY27 on 6 Nov: consolidated net profit about Rs 840 cr (+19%), revenue Rs 7,655 cr (Autocar Pro); standalone about Rs 675-680 cr (other outlets). Board approved a 1:5 split and a 3:1 bonus (NSE, 6 Nov), record date not set. Management signalled modest second-half growth amid inflation and monsoon headwinds (Sahi, Nov 2026): a minor concern, Hold. Tags: reason=news; attention=no
